## dastor serve

```bash
dastor serve CONFIG [--host 127.0.0.1] [--port 8000]
```

Serves the spool in a [config file](41-config.qmd).

## dastor browse

```bash
dastor browse PATH [--annotations DIR] [--data-dir DIR] [--host 127.0.0.1] [--port 8000] [--no-open]
```

Opens the viewer on a directory of DAS files, or on the dastor server at a URL.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | A directory, or a server's URL. A server's API key is read from `DASTOR_KEY`. |
| `--annotations` | Where a directory's annotation sets are kept; `<directory>_annotations` by default. |
| `--data-dir` | A local data directory which the viewer's Sync copies selected data into. Not inside the directory browsed. |
| `--no-open` | Don't open a browser. |

A directory is served with everything readable and re-indexed every 5 minutes, saving annotations as your system user.

## dastor new-key

Prints a new API key and its digest, for the `users` of a config.

## dastor hash-key

Prints the digest of a key read from stdin.
